oracle-l5r-4148: Kaiu Village (Region, group F): both Reactions create an Item and attach it to the entering Personality. The Armor half is buildable (Kaiu Armor, oracle-l5r-10007, is a published +1F Armor proxy), but the Weapon half needs a created "+1F/+1C Weapon Item" and no such Proxy scan exists locally: the only created Weapons are Yasunori's Gift (+1F/+0C, oracle-l5r-10019), Water Bo (+2F/+0C, oracle-l5r-10026), Flame Katana (+3F/+1C, oracle-l5r-10022) and Masayoshi's Blade (4F/1C, oracle-l5r-10204). CreatedCards.Resolve fits a created card to a published CreatedOnly scan by Force, Chi and keywords, so it cannot invent one. The rest is existing machinery: an own-personality-enters-play window (The Spider's Web's trigger) and Create-and-attach with a Fixed(2) Gold cost. Wire both halves as soon as a +1F/+1C Weapon Proxy scan (Kaiu Weapon) is fetched; a card with only one working Reaction is not published.
oracle-l5r-5979: Plains of Otosan Uchi (Region, group F): "This province holds two Dynasty cards; do not reveal the second card in the Events Phase this card enters play. You decide each time which card slot is revealed, resolved, or refilled first. Before this province is destroyed: Lose 10 Honor." Every province is modelled as exactly one card slot (ProvinceState.CardId): the Events Phase reveal loop, Purchase and Reserve recruits from a province, Refill, DestroyProvince's discard, Border Keep's and the Kharmic cycles, the private province looks, MatchView.ProvinceView and the client's province stacks all assume one card, so a second slot (a SecondCardId with its own reveal, refill, purchase and destruction paths, the controller's choice of which slot goes first, and a view/client field for it) is a structural change across the engine, the wire view and the client rather than a card-sized primitive. The 10-Honor trait ("before this province is destroyed", a cost-like loss that DestroyProvince would have to make first) is buildable once the province has both slots. Not published.
